name: Circuit Board
summary: The subject redrawn as a top-down printed circuit board: copper under green mask, gold pads and vias, white silkscreen plotted in a routed stroke font, and information running as amber and silver-cyan light along the traces, with macro depth of field.

palette.use: FR-4 laminate: what is absent, clearances, holes
copper pour under the mask: fills the board
the bevelled rim on every copper edge
current: energy light, the only saturated colour with accent2
the near-white core of the second flow
only when the whole board is the subject

type.case: capitals on the board; sentence case on the subtitle plate
type.emphasis: a pad lights, a stream changes shape, a tag prints

banned: Engineering-board photos or handwriting; white-on-blue blueprint paper
a sci-fi HUD: glass, floating panels, glowing UI chrome; a 3D circuit city, rising buildings, any perspective
decorative traces; two traces crossing on one layer; a flat empty pour
recolouring the mask per scene; red except for one fault; overexposed bloom bars
text in the depth-of-field bands or cut at the frame edge; whole sentences on the board; system fonts for subtitles
fades, wipes or page turns; hole plunges under 0.6 s; an accidental board edge in close shots
copying a real board layout, logo or part marking

sources.what: Lemo-Opuscar style No. 76 "Circuit Board" (STYLE.md, DEMO.md, style.json, demo/src/palette.js, demo/src/post.js), via research notes
